paragraphs.source_en: Truly, the deeper the problems and challenges become within families, organizations, and society, the more relevant the habits. Why? Because they’re based on universal, timeless principles of effectiveness that endure. My father didn’t claim to invent these concepts; rather, he saw them as universally accepted principles. His role was to synthesize them into habits a person could live by.
